build: Copy identical playtest_probe.rs into crates/sim/examples/ in each isolated revision; cargo build --release -p sim --example playtest_probe
contentExtraction: Parse JSON literal between = { and final }; in apps/web/src/levels/open-window.ts and turn-the-corner.ts from each revision. No authored content differs between these revisions.
visionOnDifference: Append only {gain:3,pathway:vision} to current content tuning.cues; retain baselineBrightness1, actual authored sources, all body/timing/other cues. No directional lamp added.
hashMethod: On each native Attempt frame, JSON encode tick plus each fly id/inputPose/body/events, prefix little-endian u64 byte length, append into SHA256. Excludes neural/sensory/display telemetry.
timingScope: Wall times include Attempt construction/steps/body serialization/hash. Runs shared this host concurrently and are not a performance benchmark.
scope: Eight full native attempts: baseline/current/uniform vision-on/visible-emitter model for each room, one paired seed42 each. Behavioral spot check, not statistical balance evaluation; additional light model is experimental, not shipped content.
physicalOnDifference: Current vision-on content plus normal lamp sources at visible sconce positions and visible exit PointLight position; explicit modeled rates reuse render intensity numbers and are not calibrated photometry. Baseline ambient1 retained. Sources use production FieldSet LOS; no exit-bearing signal is injected into Brain.
